_comment: Pod Security Admission levels of the six namespaces: [enforce, warn, audit]. The one source: ./portcullis (kube_cluster_setup, status) applies and checks them, templates/namespaces.yaml renders them for kubeconform. apps and storage enforce privileged (root one-shots / the storage helpers' hostPath; their admission policies pin what runs there), warn / audit baseline; ingress (NEW, HA) enforces privileged (Traefik's hostPort 80/443; portcullis-ingress-pods admits only its DaemonSet's pod shape), warn / audit baseline; nodeadm (NEW, HA) enforces privileged (its init container reads the server's etcd client key from a read-only hostPath as root), warn / audit baseline.
